result.summary: Found 4 issues including duplicated content, a cut-off card at the screen edge, and minor layout inconsistencies.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows 'Green Bowl Poké' listed twice with identical details (15-25 min, €0.90 delivery), which appears to be a duplicate content error.
issues.suggestion: Verify data source and ensure unique restaurant listings are displayed, or remove the duplicate entry.

issues.description: The third card 'Smash Bros Bu...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with text truncated abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll/carousel spacing or add a visual cue (partial card peek indicator) so users understand more content is scrollable.

issues.description: Category filter pill row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is also cut off at the right edge, hiding additional category options without a clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or arrow indicator at the edge to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, showing only a partial image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate padding/margin above the bottom navigation bar so cards are not visually clipped mid-content.
